fields.description: Quotes whose margin % falls below this warn every role. 0 disables the warning.
fields.label: Margin Floor %

fields.description: Days of client silence after a quote is sent before it is nudged. 0 disables the nudge.
fields.label: Quote Silence Nudge (days)

fields.description: What a client reads at the top of a quote. Read live at render time, so editing it changes every quote already sent — see docs/adr/0002-quote-branding-renders-live.md. Leave a field empty and its line does not print.
fields.label: Company Identity

fields.description: Public, not private — a client with no account has to be able to load it
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: Printed on the quote so a client knows where to pay. The whole block disappears when none of it is filled in.
fields.label: Bank

fields.description: Free text rather than the bank list on Party Company — one vocabulary copied a third time is worse than typing it once
fields.label: Bank Name

fields.description: Printed on the PDF only, above the space left for the seal. The client's column is left blank for hand-completion.
fields.label: Signature Block

fields.description: Days a payment milestone may stay uncollected after it falls due before it nudges. 0 disables the nudge.
fields.label: Payment Terms (days)

fields.description: A deal whose estimated budget reaches this is suggested Tier 2 (playbook §2.2). Unset falls back to 50.000.000.
fields.label: Tier 2 Threshold (VND)

fields.description: A deal whose estimated budget reaches this is suggested Tier 3. Unset falls back to 200.000.000.
fields.label: Tier 3 Threshold (VND)
